m: वश् cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 71) वष्टि, (1. pl. उश्मसि, or श्मसि, RV.; 3. pl. उशन्ति, ib.; p. उशत्, उशान and उशमान, ib.; cl. 1. वशति and cl. 3. विवष्टि [also ववष्टि], 2. sg. ववक्षि, ib.; pf. वावशुः, ˚शे; p. ˚शान, ib.; उवाश, ऊशुः Gr.; aor. अवाशीत् or अवशीत्, ib.; 2. sg. वशीह्, MBh. Prec. उश्यात् Gr.; fut. वशिता, ˚शिष्यति, ib.), to will, command (p. उशमान, ‘having at command’), RV.; AV.; to desire, wish, long for, be fond of, like (also with inf.), RV. &c. &c. (p. उशत् and उशान, ‘willing, glad, eager, zealous, obedient’; the former with superl. उशत्-तम, also = charming, lovely, BhP. [accord. to Sch. also = शुद्ध, देदीप्यमान, and स्व्-अर्चित]); to aver, maintain, affirm, declare for (two acc.), MaitrUp.; VarBṛS.; BhP. : Caus. वाशयति (aor. अवीवशत्), to cause to desire &c.; to get in one's power, subject, Cat. : Desid. विवशिषति, Gr.; Intens. वावश्यते, वावशीति, or वावष्टि, ib.; p. वावशान, ‘willing, eager’, RV.[cf. Gk. ἑκών, for ϝεκων, ‘willing’.]

AliNganAdyA nfstrIRAM kumAryyAdervvaSIkarAH ॥ 12 ॥ rocanAM nAgapuzpARi vilvapuzpaM priyaNgavaH । kuNkumaM candanaYcEva tilakena jagadbaSe ॥ 13 ॥ durAlaBA vacA kuzWaM kuNkumaYca SatAvarI । tilatElena sa karoti vaSaM sarvvaM trElokyaM nAtra saMSayaH ॥ 25 ॥ gorocanA mahAdeva ftuSoRitaBAvitA । tataH kftAcca tilakAnmAnavaM yaM nirIkzate । taYca sarvvaM vaSaM kuryyAnnAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥ 26 ॥ nAgeSvaraYca SEleyaM tvak patraYca harItakI । candanaM kAzWasUkzmElA raktaSAlisamanvitA । etErDUpo vaSakaraH smaravARa iveSvara ॥ 27 ॥ ratikAle mahAdeva pArvvatIpriya SaNkara । nijaSukraM gfhItvA tu yAni kAni ca । taRqulaYca priyaNguYca pezayedekayogataH । anena liptaliNgasya kAminI vaSatAmiyAt ॥” 30 ॥ iti mAruqe 183 । 186 । 189 aDyAyAH ॥ “aTAnyat saMpravakzyAmi vaSIkaraRamuttamam । yena nArIRAM ripURAM SamanopamaH ॥ yAvajjIvitaparyyantaM smarabARa iveSvari ! । jAyate nAtra sandehaH satyaM suragaRArccite ॥ * ॥ SletAparAjitAmUlaM pezayedrocanAyutam । SatenAmantritaM kftvA tilakaM a: वश — a. [वश् कर्तरि अच् भावे अप् वा] 1 Subject to, influenced by, under the influence or control of, usually in comp.; शोकवशः, मृत्युवशः &c. --2 Obedient, submissive, compliant. --3 Humbled, tamed. --4 Charmed, fascinated. --5 Subdued by charms. --शः, --शं 1 Wish, desire, will. --2 Power, influence, control, mastership, authority, subjection, submission; स्ववश ‘subject to oneself’, independent; परवश ‘under the influence of others’; अनयत् प्रभुशक्तिसंपदा वशमेको नृपतीननंतरान् R. 8. 19; वशं नी, or आनी to reduce to subjection, subdue, win over; वशं गम्-इ-या &c. to become subject to, give way, yield, submit; न शुचो वशं वशिनामुत्तम गंतुमर्हसि R. 8. 90; वशे कृ or वशीकृ to subdue, overcome, win over; to fascinate, be-witch. वशात् (abl.) is frequently used adverbially in the sense of ‘through the force, power or influence of’, ‘on account of’, ‘for the purpose of’; दैववशात्, वायुवशात्, कायर्वशात् &c. --3 Being tamed. --4 Birth. --शः The residence of harlots. --Comp. --अनुग, --ग, --वर्तिन् (so वशंगत) a. obedient to the will of another, submissive, subject. (--m.) a servant. --आढ्यकः a porpoise. --क्रिया winning over, subjection. --ग a. subject, obedient; नमस्यामो देवान्ननु हतविधेस्तेऽपि वशगाः Bh. 2. 94; Pt. 1. 139. --(गा) an obedient wife.

s: tri, (vaSaM tavAhaM vaSa iti vAkyaM vadatIti । vaSa + vad + “priyavaSe vadaH Kac .” 3 । 2 । 38 । iti Kac । “arurdvizadantasya mum .” 6 । 3 । 67 । iti mum .) vaSaM vadati yaH । AyattakaravAkyavaktA । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (vaSIBUtaH । yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 4 । 395 । “sa jahAra durAcAro BUBft loBavaSaMvadaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ vaSaM vaSakaraM maDuraM, vaSo'haniti vA vadati vada--Kac mum ca 1 priyavAkyavAdini 2 maDuravAdini (tavAhaM vaSaH) iti 2 vAdini ca ।
m: वश—ं-वद mfn. (mostly ifc.) submissive to the will of another, obedient, compliant, devoted or addicted to, actuated or transported or overcome with (स्वेच्छा-व्˚, dependent on one's own will), Kāv.; Sāh. &c.
a: वशंवद — a. Obedient to the will of, compliant, submissive, subject, under the influence of (lit. and fig.); कोपस्य किं नु करभोरु वशंवदाऽभूः Bv. 3. 9, 2. 136, 157; N. 1. 33; सा ददर्श गुरुहर्षवशंवदवदनमनंगनिवासं Gīt. 11; अभिसारयते कांतं या मन्मथवशंवदा S. D.

m: वश—ं-वद—त्व n. submission to the will of another, complaisance, Ragh.
वश—ं-व˚दित mfn. made compliant, fascinated, Bhām.

s: strI, (vaSaM gacCatIti । gama + qaH .) vaSIBUtA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 43 । 32 ॥ “gANgAdivAkarasutAjalacAruhArAM DAtrIM samudrarasanAM vaSagAM karoti ॥” asminnarTe vAcyaliNga evAyaM SabdaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 4 । 6 । 12 । “dadAni te hanta varaM yamicCasi praSADi matsyAn vaSago'smyahaM tava ॥”)
m: वश—गा f. an obedient wife, MW.
वश—गामिन् mfn. coming into the power (of another), becoming subject or obedient, MārkP.
वश—ग mf(आ)n. being in the power of, subject, obedient, dependent on (gen. or comp.), MBh. &c. &c.
(ifc.) subjugating, Pañcar.
वश—गमन n. the coming into the power (of another), Nir.
वश—गत mfn. subject to the will (of another), being in the power of, obedient (ifc.), Pañcat.; VarBṛS.; BhP.
वश—ग—त्व n. (ifc.) dependence on BhP.

s: strI, (vaSena AyattatayA kAyati SoBate iti । kE + kaH .) vaSyA nArI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: वशका f. an obedient wife, L.
वश—कारक mfn. leading to subjection, Pañcat.
वश—कर mf(ई)n. subjugating, winning, MBh.; Hit.

s: strI, (vaSasya kriyA karaRam .) vaSIkaraRam । tatparyyAyaH । saMvadanam 2 । ityamaraH 3 maRimantrOzaDErvvaSIkaraRaM saMvadanaM saMpUrvvo vadirvvaSIkaraRe BAve'naw । saMvadanA ca iti kecit । karaRe'nawi vaSakriyAsADane maRimantrAdAvapi । jayaSriyaH saMvadanaM yatastaditi raGuH । saMcalanaM iti pAWAntaram । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: strI vaSasya kriyA karaRaM kf--BAve Sa । vaSIkaraRe ।
m: वश—क्रिया f. the act of subduing or bewitching (esp. by charms, incantations, drugs, gems), L.
the charms &c. so used, MW.

k.v: वशक्रिया संवननं मूलकर्म तु कार्मणम्. विधूननं विधुवनं तर्पणं प्रीणनावनम्.।

m: वश—नी mfn. performing the will (of another), subject, vessel of (with gen.), RV. x, 16, 2.
वशनीय mfn. to be wished or willed, MW.
वशन n. wishing, desiring, willing &c., Pāṇ. iii, 3, 58, Vārtt. 3 Sch.
वश—स्थ mfn. being under the control (of another), MBh.
वश—ता f. subjection, the being under control of, dependence on (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Cat.
the having power over (loc.), Kāv. (v.l.)
वश-तमा f. (for वशा-त्˚) the best cow, AV. xii, 4, 42.
वश—तस् ind. (ifc.) in consequence of, on account of, through the influence of Bhartṛ.; Gol.
वश—त्व n. (ifc.) the being under the control of VarBṛS.
वश—वर्तिन् mfn. being under the control of, acting obediently to the will of, obsequious, subject (with gen. or comp.), MBh.; R. &c.
(ifc.) having power over, ruling, Lalit.
having power over all, too powerful, ib.
वश—वर्तिन् m. N. of Viṣṇu, Viṣṇ.
of a Brāhman or Mahā-Brāhman, Lalit.
sg. (scil. गण) or pl. a partic. class of gods in the third Manv-antara, VP.
वश्चिक m. N. of an Agra-hāra, Rājat.
वश्चिक m. N. of an Agra-hāra, Rājat.
वशेन्द्रिय mfn. one who has the command of his senses (-त्व n.), R.
वशेन्द्रिय—त्व n.

s: klI, (vaSa + BAve in .) vaSitvam । iti SabdamAlA ॥
m: 1. वशि mfn. = कान्त, VS. (Mahīdh.)
वशि m. subjugation, fascination, bewitching, holding others in magical submission to the will, MW.
वशि n. = वशि-त्व, L.
the state of being subject, subjection, MW.
2. वशि in comp. for वशिन्.

s: strI, (vaSo vaSIkaraRaM sADyatvenAstyasyA iti । vaS + Wan .) aguruH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥
m: वशिका f. aloe wood, MW.

v: tri॰ vaSo'styasya Wan । 1 SUnye amaraH 2 agurucandane strI ।
m: वशिक mfn. void, empty, Hcar. (written also वसिक; cf. वशिन्);

k.v: निर्णिक्तं शोधितं मृष्टं निःशोध्यमनवस्करम्. अवसारं फल्गु शून्यं तु वशिकं तुच्छरिक्तके॥

m: वशि—मन् m. the supernatural power of subduing to one's own will, MārkP.

v: tri॰ vaSo'styasya ini । 1 jitendriye 2 svADIne svatantre ca ।
m: वशिन् mfn. having will or power, having authority, a ruler, lord (‘over’ gen.), RV.; AV.; Br. &c.
compliant, obedient, VS.; TS.; Vet.
master of one's self having the mastery of one's passions, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
void, empty (properly ‘at disposal’), KātyŚr.
वशिन् m. a ruler See above
a sage with subdued passions, W.
N. of a son of Kṛti, BhP.
a: वशिन् — a. (नी f.) [वशः अस्त्यस्य इनि] 1 Powerful. --2 Being under control, subdued, subject, submissive. --3 One who has subdued his passions (used like a noun also); प्रस्थापयामास वशी वसिष्ठः R. 2. 70, 8. 90, 19. 1; Ś. 5. 28. --m. Ved. 1 A ruler, lord. --2 A sage.

s: strI, (vaSo vaSIkaraRaM sADyatvenAstyasyA iti । vaS + iniH । NIp .) vandA । SamIvfkzaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: वशिनी (इनी), f. a mistress, RV.
a parasite plant, L.
Prosopis Spicigera or Mimosa Suma, L.
वशि—प्राप्त mfn. having power over (also ifc.), Divyāv.

s: klI, (uSyate izyate iti । vaSa + bAhulakAt kirac । yadvA, vaSiM vaSatvaM rAtIti । rA + kaH .) sAmudralavaRam । ityamaraH ॥

puM, (vaSa + kirac .) gajapippalI । ityamaraH ॥ (asya paryyAyo yaTA, -- “karipippalI karuRA kapivallI kapillikA । SreyasI vaSiraScApi gajAhvA gajapippalI ॥” BuliwA iti KyAtaH । asya paryyAyo yaTA, -- “pArvvateyaSca karaBo vaSiraH kapipippalI । jAmAtAsO kvacitproktaH sUryyAvarttaH sito'paraH ॥” iti bEdyakaratnamAlA ॥) cavyam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ apAmArgaH । iti medinI । re, 208 ॥ vacA । iti SabdacandrikA ॥
v: na॰ vaSa--iran । 1 sAmudralavaRe amaraH । 2 najapippalyAm 3 cavye ca pu॰ rAjani॰ ।
m: वशिर w.r. for वसिर
a: वशिरः — A sort of pepper. --रं Seasalt.

k.v: उषणा पिप्पली शौण्डी कोलाथ करिपिप्पली। कपिवल्ली कोलवल्ली श्रेयसी वशिरः पुमान्.।
निशाख्या काञ्चनी पीता हरिद्रा वरवर्णिनी। सामुद्रं यत्तु लवणमक्षीवं वशिरं च तत्.।

s: strI, (vaSino BAvaH । vaSin + tal .) vaSitvam । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 11 । 15 । 16 । “nArAyaRe turIyAKye BagavacCabdaSabdite । mano mayyAdaDadyogI madDarmmA vaSitAmiyAt ॥”)
m: वशि—ता f. subjugation, dominion, W.

the supernatural power of subduing all to one's own will, unbounded power of (comp.; a Bodhisattva is said to have 10 Vaśitās, viz. आयुर्-, चित्त-, परिष्कार-, धर्म-, ऋद्धि-, जन्म-, अधिमुक्ति-, प्रणिधान-, कर्म-, and जान-व्˚, Dharmas. 74), BhP.; Buddh.
subduing by the use of magical means, fascinating, bewitching, W.
वशितृ mfn. having one's will free, independent, BhP.

s: klI, (vaSino BAvaH । vaSin + tva .) Ayattatvam । (yaTA, zaqratne । 1 । “SAstraM sucintitamapi praticintanIyamArADito'pi nfpatiH pariSaNkanIyaH । aNke sTitApi yuvatiH parirakzaRIyA SAstre nfpe ca yuvatO ca kuto vaSitvam ॥”) SivasyAzwESvaryyAntargatESvaryyaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “animA laGimA prAptiH prAkAmyaM mahimA taTA । ISitvaYca vaSitvaYca taTA kAmAvaSAyitA ॥” vaSitvaM svAtantryaM yena svatantraScarati ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥

m: वशि—त्व n. freedom of will, the being one's own master, MBh.; Hariv.
power or dominion over (loc.), Sarvad.
the supernatural power of subduing to one's own will, MārkP.; Pañcar. &c.
mastery of one's self, self-command, Kum.; MārkP.
subduing by magical means, fascinating, bewitching, MW.

k.v: विभूतिर्भूतिरैश्वर्यमणिमादिकमष्टधा। अणिमा महिमा चैव गरिमा लघिमा तथा। प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यमीशित्वं वशित्वं चाष्ट सिद्धयः। उमा कात्यायनी गौरी काली हैमवतीश्वरी॥

s: puM, (vaSavatAM vaSinAM SrezWaH । vaSavat + izWan । “vinmatorlaka .” 5 । 3 । 65 । iti luk .) yadvA, varizWaH । pfzodarAditvAt sADuH । asya niruktiryaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 93 । 89 । “vaSizWo'smi varizWo'smi vaSe vAsagfhezvapi । vaSizWatvAcca vAsAcca vaSizWa iti vidDi mAm ॥”) svanAmaKyAtamuniH । tapayyAyaH । arunDatIjAniH 2 । iti hemacandraH ॥ arunDatInATaH 3 vASizWaH 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ sa tu brahmaRaH prAReByo jAtaH । tasya BAryyA karddamakanyA arunDatI । puttrAH saptarzayaH । iti SrIBAgavatamatam ॥ api ca । “vaSizWaSca taTo rjjayAM sapta puttrAnajIjanat । kanyAYca puRqarIkAkzAM sarvvaSoBAsamanvitAm ॥ rajo gAtrordvabAhuSca mavanaScAnavastaTA । sutapAH Sukra ityete sapta puttrA mahOjasaH । sarvve tapasvinaH proktAH sarvve yajYezu BAginaH । ayajvAnaSca yajvAnaH pitaro brahmaRaH sutAH ॥” iti kOrmme 12 aDyAyaH ॥ mitrAvaruRayoH puttraH । yaTA, -- “iti pfzwA narendreRa kaTyatAmiti BUpate । vaSizWaM codayAmAsuH samastAste tapoDanAH ॥ muniBiH preritaH so'pi yaTAvadyatamAnasaH । yogamAsTAya suciraM mEtrAvaruRirAtmavAn ॥” anyacca । “mitrAvaruRayoScEva kuRqino ye pariSrutAH । ekArzeyAstaTEvAnye vaSizWA nAma viSrutAH ॥ ete pakzA vaSizWAnAM smftA hyekAdaSEva tu । azwAvete samAKyAtA brahmaRo mAnasAHsutAH ॥” iti vahnipurARe GftaDenuviDivArAhaprAdurBAvADyAyO ॥
v: atiSayena vaSI izWan inerluk । atiSayajitendriyatAyukte muniBede ।
m: वशिष्ठ w.r. for वसिष्ठ.
वश्मसा ind. g. ऊर्य्-आदि.
वश्मसा ind. g. ऊर्य्-आदि.

s: strI, (vaSya + wAp .) vaSIBUtA nArI । tatparyyAyaH । vaSagA 2 vaSAsyA 3 vaSyakA 4 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, uttararAmacarite 1 aNke । 1 । “yaM brAhmaRamiyaM devI vAgvaSyevAnuvarttate । uttaraM rAmacaritaM tatpraRItaM prayokzyate ॥”)
m: वश्या f. a docile and obedient wife, W.
वश्यात्मन् mfn. of subdued mind, Bhag.

s: klI, (vaSAya vaSIkaraRAya sADu । “tatra sADuH .” 4 । 4 । 98 । iti yat .) lavaNgam । iti SabdacandrikA ॥

tri, (vaSamaDInatvaM gata iti । vaS + “vaSaM gataH .” 4 । 4 । 86 । iti yat .) AyattatAM gataH । tatparyyAyaH । praReyaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ vaSaH 3 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, mArkaRqeyapurARe । 39 । 17 । “mfdutvaM sevyamAnAstu siMhaSAdrdUlakuYjarAH । yaTA yAnti taTA prARo vaSyo Bavati yoginaH ॥” agniDrasya paYcamaH puttraH । yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 53 । 34 । “harirvarzastftIyastu caturTo'BUdilAvftaH । vaSyaSca paYcamaH putro hiraRyaH zazWa ucyate ॥”)
v: na॰ vaSa--yat । 1 lavaNge Sabdara॰ । 2 Abatte tri॰ amaraH
m: वश्य mfn. to be subjected &c.
subdued, tamed, humbled
being under control, obedient to another's will, dutiful, docile, tame, humble, at the disposal of (gen. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वश्य m. a dependent, slave, MW.
N. of a son of Āgnīdhra, MārkP.
वश्य f. (Cat.) or n. (ib.; Prab.) the supernatural power of subjecting to one's own will, any act (such as the repetition of spells) performed with that object, VarBṛS.; Gṛhyās.
वश्य m. cloves, W.
a: वश्य — a. [वश्-यत्] 1 Capable of being subdued, controllable, governable; आत्मवश्यैर्विधेयात्मा प्रसादमधिगच्छति Bg. 2. 64. --2 Subdued, conquered, tamed, humbled; Bg. 6. 36. --3 Under influence or control, subject, dependent, obedient; तस्य पुत्रो भवेद्वश्यः समृद्धो धार्मिकः सुधीः H. Pr. 18; oft. in comp.; (मनः) हृदि व्यवस्थाप्य समाधिवश्यं Ku. 3. 50. --श्यः A servant, dependant. --श्या An humble or obedient wife; यं ब्राह्मणमियं देवी वाग्वश्येवानुवर्तते U. 1. 2 (who has full command of language). --श्यं Cloves.

k.v: वश्यः प्रणेयो निभृतविनीतप्रश्रिताः समाः। धृष्टे धृष्णग्वियातश्च प्रगल्भः प्रतिभान्विते॥

s: strI (vaSyA + svArTe kan .) vaSagA strI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: वश्यका f. an obedient wife, ib.
वश्य—कारिन् mfn. = -कर, L.
वश्यक mf(आ)n. obedient, dutiful, L.
= वश्य above, MW.
वश्यक n. वश्य-कर्मन् above, Cat.
वश्य—कर mfn. giving power over others, Cat.
वश्य—कर्मन् n. the act of subjecting to one's will (by spells &c.), Cat.
वश्य—ता, f. (MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.) or वश्य—त्व, n. (MBh.; R.) the being under the control of (gen. or comp.), fitness for subjection, obedience, humility.
